notes.title: 「Fireworks Festival」Theme Update
notes.content: [p][b]Stroll through dreamy garden paths in your yukata at the Fireworks Festival![/b][/p][p]Six new sprites with exclusive ornaments await at the summer festival![/p][h3]Yukata hems flutter over stone steps, painting a unique scene[/h3][p]Wooden geta chime with bellflowers, as floral scents and oil-paper umbrellas unfurl into a flowing stream in the twilight.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45341010/0734f5cfac092f10f0ca0c9b862fa054a7d7f09f.png"][/img][/p][h3]Fox masks glow mysteriously, hiding secrets within[/h3][p]White foxes blink beneath paper lanterns, their vermillion-painted ears trembling while eavesdropping on countless deities' whispers in the wind.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45341010/53a77db6cf77aa997a71dbbc4e75a5f9ec341cd0.png"][/img][/p][h3]Pray for next year's abundance at the divine dwelling[/h3][p]Vermilion torii gates clasp the setting sun. Wind chimes shatter the cicadas' chorus as thousands of wishes sprout within each [i]ding-dong[/i].[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45341010/d1f8df4ac55fc1bf81b1d7c8b0113fb2498309f6.png"][/img][/p][h3]Tiny paper nets capturing countless dreams[/h3][p]Golden fish dart like glazed glass through the water, rippling with the fleeting encounters of this world.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45341010/fa1748da86c0358e9e9ee062daf03acc701c7eb3.png"][/img][/p][h3]Moonlit tamago-yaki skewered on bamboo, carrying ocean memories[/h3][p]Bamboo sticks pierce crispy clouds—waves burst on the tongue as Seto Inland Sea octopus tentacles dance in sea salt.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45341010/11572d5c93c39695b945a31719669f7fa4d5ff8b.png"][/img][/p][h3]Golden sea bream leaps skyward, symbolizing soaring fortune[/h3][p]Gilded scales crackle open, spilling molten red bean paste like sunset glow pooling in your palms.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45341010/b381cdaf60586e7a20daeef86dfed17998f4182f.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: 「Summer」Theme Update
notes.content:
[b]Bask in the sun and embrace the vibrant season of summer![/b]
6 Brand-New Sprites and Their Exclusive Summer-Themed Decorations
Summer is here!


[h3]Dive into an Ice Cream Extravaganza![/h3]

Conquer the summer heat with frosty treats in dazzling flavors – savor sweet refreshment under the blazing sun!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45341010/408a2b57e5c37e68f4e14104dc722d40d9c36f22.png[/img]

[h3]Kickstart Your Day with Zesty Lemonade![/h3]

Sip tangy lemonade and let citrusy freshness dance on your tongue – the ultimate thirst-quencher for scorching days!  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45341010/d6067ca4a1a1a498e713692858084ec220ae05a6.png[/img]

[h3]Tranquil Beauty by the Lotus Pond[/h3]

Watch pink-and-white lotus petals unfurl, painting serene waters with whispers of summer grace.   

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45341010/783fd7f914f4143791bd821fee024d8605faeaa7.png[/img]

[h3]Golden Sunflower Fields: Chasing Solar Romance[/h3]

Wander through golden seas of sunflowers, their faces lifted boldly to chase the fiery sun’s embrace.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45341010/275dddf5e904a77264f221592d9535d10e3b9bf0.png[/img]

[h3]Gather ‘Round the Bonfire with Frosty Brews![/h3]

Beneath starry skies, let toasted marshmallows mingle with frothy sips of chilled beer – the truest way to celebrate summer nights! 
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45341010/440806ada6d5cb190d4a65372d1abe7b2062bb02.png[/img]

[h3]Splash into Waterpark Revelry![/h3]

Leap into crystal-clear pools, float with rubber ducks, and fill endless summer days with laughter and waves!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45341010/54a64703efebaa6195cd494056a3432b5e9f980e.png[/img]

notes.title: 20250526 Bug Fixes and Optimizations
notes.content:
1. Added cloud save functionality  
2. Added achievements feature  
3. Added the ability to select multiple items for purchase in the Fairy Shop  
4. Added the option to purchase 10 items at once in the Fairy Shop  
5. Added display of item names  
6. Various bug fixes

notes.title: 20250508Fixed issues including lag, item disappearance, and map misalignment
notes.content:
1：Fixed map item overlapping caused by slow map loading speeds and batch movements, as well as the inability to delete bugged tiles.

2：Fully repaired corrupted save files, with misplaced items restored to the backpack.

3：Optimized map loading performance to resolve slow loading issues on large maps.

4：Added VSync to fix screen tearing caused by monitor refresh rate discrepancies.

5：Fixed various other bugs.

notes.title: 「Spring」Theme Update
notes.content:
[b]Spring has arrived once again. Let’s welcome the season together![/b]

6 Brand-New Sprites and Their Exclusive Decorations
Spring is here!


[h3]Fly Kites and Enjoy Green Rice Dumplings[/h3]
Feel the spring breeze on the grass, fly kites, savor green rice dumplings… What a leisurely weekend!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45341010/ce85a65f02e3c050fa24c6022254243f34db0fd8.png[/img]

[h3]Sketch in the Tulip Garden[/h3]
The variety and colors of tulips are truly dazzling. Which one is your favorite?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45341010/4d05593f56798baaa20a63c5adca81486f99a6fb.png[/img]

[h3]Indulge in Delicious Cherry Cake[/h3]
Sweet and juicy cherries pair perfectly with cake!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45341010/f8cf6ea9904d8d0fbc6fd78b885b29efd045d1df.png[/img]

[h3]Antique-Style Plum Blossom Garden[/h3]
Stroll through a world of plum blossoms and immerse yourself in this unique atmosphere.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45341010/6f4843d52a7a7f24cdfb64c1f3bdd9dee8caf04c.png[/img]

[h3]Plant Trees, Cherish Our Home[/h3]
Protect our Earth by starting with planting a tree this spring.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45341010/ce161bdc6bc71caa1f56db513756caca1db2af60.png[/img]

[h3]Dig for Bamboo Shoots with Pandas![/h3]
Adorable pandas and fresh, delicious bamboo shoots – it’s a tough choice to make!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45341010/3ad5142aa3b191ca374f2f309b2f76d5a1447371.png[/img]

notes.title: 20250424Bug Fixes and Optimizations
notes.content:
1.Added the Bird Encyclopedia.
2.Items can now be sorted by time, name, or number.
3.Clicking on plots allows you to change their style.
4.Fixed various bugs.

notes.title: Overall Movement Feature Update (20250325)
notes.content:
更新整体移动的功能
选中地基可以整体移动地基上的所有物品
左Ctrl+鼠标左键拖动可以选中范围内的所有物品，进行整体移动
修复若干bug

Updated the overall movement functionality.
Selecting the foundation now allows moving all items on it as a whole.
Use Left Ctrl + Left-click and drag to select and move all items within a range.
Fix several bugs

notes.title: 20250311bug修复与优化
notes.content:
1：放置时鼠标滚轮放大缩小与反转冲突，改为放置固定视野大小，只进行反转
2：游戏后台时游戏音效停止
3：精灵商店右下角物品无法选中，已修复
4：修复若干bug
其他：
整体移动和物品栏筛选排序正在制作中

1: When placing, there is a conflict between zooming in and out of the mouse wheel and reversing it. Instead, place it with a fixed field of view size and only reverse it
2: Game sound effects stop in the background of the game
3: The item in the bottom right corner of the Pok é mon store cannot be selected, it has been fixed
4: Fix several bugs
other:
The overall movement and item selection sorting are currently in progress

notes.title: 20250309bug修复与优化
notes.content:
1.金币（星星）增加了具体数量显示，上限增加为99999，掉出罐子后不会扣除
2.放置、移动物品时，可以同时移动屏幕
3.优化了新手引导
4.修复若干bug

1. Gold coins (stars) have increased their specific quantity display, with an upper limit of 99999, and will not be deducted after falling out of the jar
When placing or moving items, the screen can be moved simultaneously
3. Optimized beginner guidance
4. Fix several bugs
